1. Could zip 20260816141814815 be reprocessed without the zero-filled XML, to recover 8/16 09h? Its first half is already loaded, so a skip on existing filenames would avoid duplicates.

direct_evidence.title: 2026-09-24-rcs-28281-comentario-interno | 3. Troubleshooting performed, and the limits of support access
direct_evidence.body:
## 3. Troubleshooting performed, and the limits of support access

Claude proposed the load, blob and repo checks and wrote the queries. I ran them myself in GP9 and Snowflake, and read the blob listing in Storage Explorer and the c112ahl repo. This is what I think is happening: the zips that arrived during 20:30 to 22:20 did not carry the transactions for that window, or those XMLs errored during ingest. Could someone else evaluate this and give me your thoughts?

Support cannot decrypt the `.zip.pgp` files. I tried the pyARDM log share `\\dsprod1\retail\logs\c112ahl\ardm` from the Bastion VM QA-LPMS-RDP-001 and got `0x80004005`, so the logs and the `xml\error` folder remain unchecked.

Pipeline `Migrated To Snowflake - c112ahl ARDM Daily Production GP9` is Disabled since 9/3. Its 8/27 scheduled run failed and was rerun manually twice.

Outside the ticket: Ayesha's Teams thread in Retail Ops, Data Issues, 8/27, and the ADUSA email thread https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/RTS-205639. No calls.

direct_evidence.body:
## Actualización, 24 sep tarde

Verificado por Juan: Snowflake ARDMPROD.ARDM_112.ARDM_HEADER coincide minuto a minuto con GP9. El 8/12 tiene 1,922,680 filas y el mismo número de filename distintos. No hay duplicados.
Verificado por Juan: la carpeta 13 del blob tiene 164 zips. Llegaron zips Ahold_TLOG_20260812 cada diez minutos desde las 00:17 UTC, con sufijos de 2015 a 2315. H2 queda refutada: DXC sí transmitió en esas horas.
Hipótesis nueva: esos zips no traían las transacciones de 20:55 a 22:19, o los XML fallaron en la ingesta. Se decide abriendo los zips, porque el nombre de cada XML empieza con la hora de la transacción. Eso requiere desencriptar y lo hace el Data Team.
Logs de pyARDM, según prod_ardm.yml: \\dsprod1\retail\logs\c112ahl\ardm. Errores de XML: carpeta xml\error bajo la ruta cruda del cliente.
Nota interna reescrita en inbox/2026-09-24-rcs-28281-comentario-interno.md.
